changes.reason: Standalone subscriptions retain request scope through response completion, failure, cancellation and abort; delayed iterator operations retain GraphQL authority without taking ownership of an inherited scope.

kubernetes.reason: Standalone SSE and the existing Node listener reuse Context explicit scope ownership. Local Node tests do not verify a Kubernetes deployment.
constraints: Consume, cancel or abort every subscription response. No deployed cluster certification.

aws-lambda.reason: The existing Node-based GraphQL handler can be composed only within the host invocation lifetime; this fix does not add Lambda SSE support.
constraints: Complete or cancel the body before invocation return and telemetry flush. Lambda streaming is not certified.

cloudflare.reason: The Workers fetch-only entrypoint explicitly rejects subscription schemas. Standalone GraphQLServer remains a Node entrypoint.
constraints: Workers query/mutation support is unchanged; this change does not enable Workers subscriptions.
